# E0402: a lacuna has no message

Every lacuna has a message: the human-readable account of the gap in the
translation. This one has none.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:  string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
		lacunas: [
			{type: "DroppedField", condition: input.b != _|_},
		]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0402]: lacuna 0 of lens 0.1->0.0 has no message
  --> lineage.cue:24:4
   |
24 |             {type: "DroppedField", condition: input.b != _|_},
   |             ^
   |
```
